queries.label: Selective status filter
queries.logq: select count(*) from it where status_code = 503
queries.duckdb: SELECT count(*) FROM read_ndjson_auto('{data}') WHERE status_code = 503
queries.clickhouse: SELECT count() FROM file('{data}', JSONEachRow) WHERE status_code = 503

queries.label: Group by status
queries.logq: select status_code, count(*) as count from it group by status_code
queries.duckdb: SELECT status_code, count(*) AS count FROM read_ndjson_auto('{data}') GROUP BY status_code
queries.clickhouse: SELECT status_code, count() AS count FROM file('{data}', JSONEachRow) GROUP BY status_code

queries.label: Top-10 latency
queries.logq: select request_id, latency from it order by latency desc limit 10
queries.duckdb: SELECT request_id, latency FROM read_ndjson_auto('{data}') ORDER BY latency DESC LIMIT 10
queries.clickhouse: SELECT request_id, latency FROM file('{data}', JSONEachRow) ORDER BY latency DESC LIMIT 10

queries.label: User-agent substring
queries.logq: select count(*) from it where user_agent like "%Chrome%"
queries.duckdb: SELECT count(*) FROM read_ndjson_auto('{data}') WHERE user_agent LIKE '%Chrome%'
queries.clickhouse: SELECT count() FROM file('{data}', JSONEachRow) WHERE user_agent LIKE '%Chrome%'
